summary: Join our Smart Spatial Analysis course to master AI and drone technology for urban planning. Elevate your expertise and drive innovative city solutions!
lede: AI-assisted spatial analysis combines GIS layers, drone imagery and machine learning to inform urban planning decisions. For planners, GIS analysts and spatial teams, it supports zoning, site suitability and development monitoring with evidence drawn from maps and imagery. The course covers spatial data preparation, drone mapping, image classification and accuracy assessment, plus suitability analysis, access mapping and planning reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with maps, planning data, or spatial workflows and now need to use artificial intelligence and drones more confidently. It fits both operational practitioners and planning leaders who must translate spatial analysis into evidence that supports real decisions. Urban planners responsible for zoning evidence and site suitability decisions. GIS analysts producing spatial layers for development and service planning. Remote sensing specialists validating drone imagery and change-detection outputs. Transport planners mapping accessibility, catchments, and corridor demand. City development officers coordinating spatial evidence for capital projects. Land-use planners reviewing growth pressures and development applications. Geospatial data analysts maintaining planning databases and map products. Infrastructure planners prioritizing projects using spatial demand indicators. Smart city coordinators integrating AI and drone outputs into workflows. Survey and mapping technicians supporting drone acquisition and processing.
modules: Governance for Spatial AI and Drone Use
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with geospatial datasets, drone imagery examples, and planning maps. Prior experience with GIS software is recommended, and basic familiarity with urban planning workflows will help you complete the spatial analysis exercises more effectively.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
